supersedes.reason: The superseded draft placed authorization files inside the wrapper directory and therefore changed the wrapper tree it purported to bind. It carries no submission authority.

scope.scientific_question: Does the clean transplanted Engine-A package execute under the registered bounded pilot contract and emit its expected engineering receipts?
not_authorized: source or wrapper modification after preflight

required_preflight: the tracked working tree is clean
the exact engine and wrapper tree SHAs are present under the NQ subtree
the registered submit script is contained in the unchanged authorized wrapper tree
the authorization directory is not contained in the wrapper tree
the LUNARC account is available to the operator
no receipt exists for the nonduplication key
the operator records the checked-out commit and all tree-to-path bindings
required_receipts: scheduler account and effective resource request
sacct terminal state, exit code, elapsed time, MaxRSS, and allocation

promotion_ceiling.maximum_authority: bounded engineering execution receipt on the exact authorized payload
